title: Upper Bounds for the Largest Laplacian Eigenvalue of Simplicial Complexes
summary: Let $K$ be a finite $r$-dimensional simplicial complex with vertex set $V$ of size $n$. We study the largest eigenvalue of the combinatorial $(r-1)$-up Laplacian $L^{\operatorname{up}}_{r-1}(K)$. It is known that \[ λ_{\max}\bigl(L^{\operatorname{up}}_{r-1}(K)\bigr)\le n. \] We first give a homological equality criterion for this universal bound, namely, the equality holds if and only if the $r$-dimensional complement $K^c$ of $K$ has a nonzero reduced homology $\widetilde H_{r-1}(K^c,\mathbb{R})$. For $r=1$, this is the classical graph condition that the complement graph is disconnected.…
